    heating_upgrade_tensor

    heating_upgrade_tensor.Rd

    This is a core function of hpmicrosimr. heating_upgrade_tensor calculates an element of the heating system upgrade cost tensor i.e. the costs and cost savings (hli_old,tech_old) -> (hli_new,tech_new)

    heating_upgrade_tensor(
  hli_old,
  hli_new,
  tech_old,
  installation_time,
  tech_new,
  house_type,
  storeys,
  construction_year,
  region,
  floor_area,
  cost_model = "logistic",
  params,
  upgrade_heat = FALSE,
  is_fuel_allowance = FALSE,
  include_grants = TRUE,
  include_rebound = FALSE
)

    Arguments

    hli_old

    old ber double

    hli_new

    new ber double

    tech_old

    old tech

    installation_time

    time of installation of current system (for estimate of old operating cost only)

    tech_new

    new tech

    house_type

    house type in seai codes

    storeys

    number of storeys 1, 2+

    construction_year

    year,integer

    region

    region

    floor_area

    floor area of property in m2

    cost_model

    ber upgrade cost model (power, logistic or esri) default logistic

    params

    params

    upgrade_heat

    TRUE if current heating system is upgraded

    is_fuel_allowance

    TRUE/FALSE

    include_grants

    TRUE/FALSE

    include_rebound

    defulat FALSE

    Value

    list

    Details

    fabric upgrade costs are discounted with infinite lifetime. Present bias (params$beta.) is included for new investments. An additional sludge/

    the new tech is installed at current time (params$yeartime). The old tech installation time is also specified.

    All applicable grants used by default, the effects of grants can optionally be excluded by setting include_grants=FALSE

    Optionally, the current (old) heating system can be retained

    Used with optimise_upgrade to determine the optimal upgrade path tech_old -> tech_new and hli_old -> hli_new

    Examples

    
params <- scenario_params(sD,2026)

heating_upgrade_tensor(1.8,1.5,"gas",2005,"heat_pump","semi_detached",2,1990,"Dublin",100,cost_model="logistic",params,TRUE,FALSE,TRUE)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 8
#>   new_cost old_cost savings upgrade_cost heating_sys_cost grant_type
#>      <dbl>    <dbl>   <dbl>        <dbl>            <dbl> <chr>     
#> 1    1272.    2226.  -0.428       14954.           11172. OSS       
#> # ℹ 2 more variables: upgrade_grant <dbl>, heat_pump_grant <dbl>

heating_upgrade_tensor(4,3,"oil",2000,"heat_pump","terraced",2,1980,"Munster",90,"logistic",params,TRUE,FALSE,TRUE,include_rebound=TRUE)

#> 1    3580.    2789.   0.284        4795.           14797. BetterEnergyHomes

heating_upgrade_tensor(2,1.2,"oil",2000,"heat_pump","semi_detached",2, 1980,"Munster",100,"logistic",params,TRUE,FALSE,TRUE,include_rebound=FALSE)
